title: On the Non-Generation of Magnetic Fields by Moving Charges and the Origin of Planetary Magnetic Fields
content: Based on the “Unified Theory of Fields,” we have previously discussed the essence of magnetic fields; however, several critical questions remained unsettled: 1) whether moving charges produce magnetic fields—in other words, whether magnetic fields originate from moving charges—and 2) the essence and origin of planetary magnetic fields.  The reason these two crucial issues have not been fully resolved is that, at that time, we had not yet found sufficient evidence to support our conclusions.  Meanwhile, the “ ” phenomenon described in the Unified Theory of Fields and its consequences were not analyzed in greater detail.  Therefore, this paper will provide comprehensive and definitive answers to the above two questions.
